data.title: From robot dogs to helpers, China puts robotics ambitions on display at world conference
data.description: China has kicked off the 2026 World Robot Conference in Beijing, showcasing its expanding robotics industry. Organizers say around 3,000 products will be featured during the five-day event.
data.author: E. EDUARDO CASTILLO The Associated Press
